sources.title: Saudi Film Commission (film.sa): Incentive Program (Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2026-39 copy, captured 2026-09-12)
sources.said: Financial Support: A rebate program offering up to 60% of production expenses. … The Incentive Program is available to local and international production companies (with a local entity or Saudi partner). … What Is the Minimum Eligible Expenditure? Feature Films: SAR 750,000 in eligible expenses (approximately $200,000 per project). Feature Documentaries: SAR 187,000 … Feature Animation Films: SAR 187,000 … the minimum number of filming days required to qualify for the financial rebate incentive is 5 days with the main production unit. … Above-the-Line (ATL) Team: Producer fees (including script rights costs). Director fees (including screenplay rights).

sources.title: الصندوق الثقافي يطلق أحدث برامجه … في قطاع الأفلام (Cultural Development Fund release via PR Newswire, 16 Mar 2023)
sources.said: وأشار الأستاذ محمد بن دايل، الرئيس التنفيذي للصندوق الثقافي خلال الإعلان عن البرنامج، بتفعيل البرنامج لمسارين تمويليين وهما " الإقراض " و"الاستثمار"
